item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem: Meena's father wants to replace the old wiring in their house in Jaipur. He asks Meena which property of a material makes it suitable for drawing into wires, and which material he should choose. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Steel is suitable for making wires because it contains carbon.
options.B: Copper is suitable because it is ductile and can be drawn into wires.
options.C: Shiny coal is suitable for drawing into wires because it is a non-metal.
options.D: Any strong or hard solid can be made into wire if enough force is used.
